mustHaves: Self-hosted web application for a tenant, not a landlord
Reads an uploaded lease PDF and extracts the notice, renewal and rent review dates
Sends reminders ahead of each notice deadline
Publishes the dates as a calendar feed
niceToHaves: Lets the user correct extracted dates by hand
Keeps a history of rent changes

mustHaves: Records a shell session and turns it into a step-by-step runbook in Markdown
Replaces hostnames, addresses and secret-looking values with named placeholders automatically
Keeps the output of each command next to the command, trimmed to the relevant lines
Runs locally with no cloud service
niceToHaves: Lets a teammate replay the runbook with their own placeholder values
Flags commands that were typed and then undone

mustHaves: Records the user practising an instrument through the microphone
Detects the tempo actually played, not the metronome setting
Stores one entry per piece and per session
Charts the tempo progress of each piece over weeks
niceToHaves: Warns when the player speeds up during a passage

mustHaves: Self-hosted web application for an amateur choir
Imports a score as MusicXML and generates one practice audio file per voice part, with that part louder than the others
Each member has an account and is assigned a voice part
Logs which pieces each member practised and for how long
Shows the choir director, per piece, which members have not practised yet
niceToHaves: Adjustable tempo for the practice audio

mustHaves: Self-hosted web application for a community seed library
Reads a photo of a seed packet with OCR and records the variety and harvest year
Records germination test results for each batch of seeds
Emails the members who borrowed a variety when its germination rate falls below a set threshold
niceToHaves: Suggests which varieties should be grown out again this season

mustHaves: Command line tool that scans a folder of Markdown meeting notes
Collects action items assigned to each person across all files
Marks an action item as done when a later note says it was completed
Prints a list of the items still open per person
niceToHaves: Shows how long each item has been open
